headline: Prime angle but no swell — glassy and flat.
today: Prime SSE direction is wasted on sub-foot short-period mush. Dawn cross-off is glassy but there's nothing to ride, and it goes onshore hard by afternoon. Not worth waxing up.

daysToWatch.note: Best day of the stretch. Up to 3.7ft at 6.6s on a prime angle with light NE morning wind. Shortboard, mid-morning, before the tide and evening breeze shift.
Waist-to-chest SE on a prime angle, dawn cross-off. Short period keeps it soft but it's rideable early — fish or groveler.
